# Konneckin

> Konneckin simplifies business expansion into Indonesia — offering expert market entry services including company registration, market research, licensing, payroll, tax, and compliance support for companies and individuals entering the Indonesian market.

## Services
- [Business Expansion](https://www.konneckin.com/business-expansion): Market entry into Indonesia via compliance, local insight, and strategic partnerships
- [Company Registration](https://www.konneckin.com/company-registration): Company incorporation (PT PMA, etc.) guided by local legal experts
- [Company Regulation](https://www.konneckin.com/company-regulation): Setting up a company in Indonesia the right way, from PT PMA to Representative Office
- [Business Matchmaking](https://www.konneckin.com/business-matchmaking): Connecting clients with verified partners, investors, and customers
- [Licensing](https://www.konneckin.com/licensing): Business licensing — NIB, Industrial License, Construction License (IUJK), Trade License
- [Product Certification & Regulatory Compliance](https://www.konneckin.com/product-certification-regulatory-compliance): Regulatory guidance to get products to market faster
- [Importer of Record](https://www.konneckin.com/importer-of-record): Customs compliance and import clearance without a local legal entity
- [Market Research](https://www.konneckin.com/market-research): Data-driven insights on competitors, trends, and opportunities
- [Payroll Management](https://www.konneckin.com/payroll-management): Accurate, confidential, compliant payroll processing in Indonesia
- [Tax & Accounting Solutions](https://www.konneckin.com/tax-accounting-solutions): Tax compliance and financial optimization
- [Recruitment Service](https://www.konneckin.com/recruitment-service): Executive search and specialist hiring in Indonesia
- [Expatriate Support](https://www.konneckin.com/expatriate-support): Visas/KITAS/KITAP, relocation, and personal tax compliance for foreign talent
- [KITAS Visa Services](https://www.konneckin.com/kitas): Investor, Working, Director/Commissioner, Dependent, and Second Home visas
- [Post-Establishment Services](https://www.konneckin.com/post-establishment): Ongoing compliant support after company registration
- [Industries](https://www.konneckin.com/industries): Sector expertise overview
- [Industry Coverage](https://www.konneckin.com/industry-coverage): Healthcare, Financial/Strategic Investors, TMT, Consumer & Retail, Natural Resources
